headline: CHW @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 3.83 at NYY 5.06, with a projected total of 8.89. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CHW +0.29, NYY +0.31), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.58, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Carlos Rodón has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Chase Meidroth, Cody Bellinger, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ali Sánchez, Edgar Quero because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
